article.headline: Lander scores 18, LIU takes down Wagner 60-47
article.description: — Blake Lander scored 18 points as Long Island University beat Wagner 60-47 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Lander scores 18, LIU takes down Wagner 60-47

categories.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Wagner Seahawks

event.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Wagner Seahawks

keywords: Long Island University Sharks @ Wagner Seahawks
article.story: NEW YORK -- — Blake Lander scored 18 points as Long Island University beat Wagner 60-47 on Thursday night. Lander also contributed six rebounds for the Sharks (11-15, 7-4 Northeast Conference). Jamal Fuller scored 18 points and added six rebounds. Malachi Davis had 13 points and went 5 of 14 from the field (2 for 7 from 3-point range). Zaire Williams led the Seahawks (12-11, 4-6) in scoring, finishing with 13 points, six rebounds and three steals. Wagner also got nine points from Tyje Kelton. Keyontae Lewis also had eight points and eight rebounds. NEXT UP Both teams play on Saturday. LIU hosts Stonehill and Wagner travels to play Fairleigh Dickinson. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
